flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The Indian economy is expected to grow over 7% in the upcoming year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "The Indian economy is expected to grow over 7% in the upcoming year, mainly driven by strong public demand and resilient private consumption." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The Board approved an investment of up to 3 crores in Murli Solar Energy Private Limited towards sourcing green power.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "In line with sustainability goals, the Board has approved an investment of up to `3 crores, in Murli Solar Energy Private Limited (SPV of Sunsure Energy Pvt Limited) towards sourcing green power." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: Strategic investments were made in advanced windshield preprocessing lines transitioning from manual to automated processes.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "In line with the increasing demand for high-quality, large-format windshields, your Company has made strategic investments in advanced windshield preprocessing lines. The shift from manual to automated cutting and grinding processes has significantly enhanced..." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: A automobile & auto components tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management noted that electric vehicle adoption is accelerating in three-wheelers, with traditional large OEMs outperforming new entrants.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Electric vehicle adoption is accelerating in three-wheelers, with traditional large OEMs outperforming new entrants and consolidating their positions." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: The automotive sector demonstrated resilience with overall vehicle sales showing year-on-year growth.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The automotive sector demonstrated commendable resilience during FY 2024-25, with overall vehicle sales showing year-on-year growth." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company plans to strengthen its market presence by supplying key customers and engaging with others following the introduction of air-conditioned cabins.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "We have started supplying one key customer and are in discussions with others, aiming to strengthen our market presence." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: The growth strategy focuses on increasing business with current customers, broadening value-added offerings in commercial vehicles, successfully executing new light commercial vehicle programs, and expanding...
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Our growth strategy focuses on increasing business with current customers, broadening value-added offerings in commercial vehicles, successfully executing new light commercial vehicle programs, and expanding further in the bus body market." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company plans to expand in the OEM segment focusing on 3-wheelers, trucks, LCVs, buses, and aftermarket categories.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Your Company is strategically aligned with this shift, focusing on expanding in the OEM segment, particularly in 3-wheelers, trucks, Light Commercial Vehicles (“LCVs”), buses, and aftermarket categories." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹2.5 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 15, 2026, has recommended a Final Dividend of ₹2.5 per share." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: The total CSR expenditure for the financial year 2025-26 was ₹83 Lakhs.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "During FY 2025-26, we spent `83 Lakhs in various CSR initiatives, as outlined in Annexure 5 of this report." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: High inflationary impact from raw glass costs, rupee depreciation, high-cost imports, and raw material price increases were partly offset by price increases.
opportunities.evidence: Margins / costs: "The high inflationary impact from raw glass costs, the rupee depreciation against dollar, high-cost imports, cost increases by almost all raw material suppliers were partly offset with price increase." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Non-compliance with increasingly stringent environmental norms may result in liabilities and reputational damage.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Non-compliance to increasing stringent regulatory environmental norms may result in liabilities and damage to reputation." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The commercial vehicle segment encountered challenges with declining volumes caused by infrastructure project delays during the general election period.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The commercial vehicle segment encountered challenges, witnessing a decline in volumes attributable to delays in new infrastructure projects amid the general election period during the first nine months of the fiscal year." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The company is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations from global financial market volatility.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The Company is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations arising from volatility in global financial markets, which may affect its financial performance." (annual report - 2025-03-31)
